title: Rating buttons
brief: A one to five rating scale on butter yellow: outlined square buttons, 4 selected in solid ink, a yellow tint on hover and an orange ring on keyboard focus.

inspiration.note: Took the heavy dark outline and high-contrast focus colour on choice controls; ours is a horizontal numeric scale of square buttons.
Took the row of equal buttons with one selected; spacing, ink-on-butter palette and end labels are ours.
